caption: The drawing features a sleeveless, light tan or beige garment, likely a waistcoat or vest, depicted on a plain off-white background. The garment reaches past the waist and is slightly flared at the bottom, with two pointed, skirt-like extensions in the front. The front edges of the garment are embellished with a patterned trim and decorated with a row of ornamental buttons or similar circular designs running vertically down the center, suggesting a closure. Additional decorative stitching or tufted motifs are scattered uniformly across the surface in small clusters. At the vest’s bottom front, each skirted extension displays double-bordered, inset panels with additional line work and decorative trim in darker ink. The edges of the garment, as well as all details, are outlined in black or dark brown ink, and sections within the panels consist of further repetitive decorative motifs. The drawing is signed "Lillian Causey" in the bottom right corner.
title: Man's Vest
